messages.content:
={{ `Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background with data science bootcamp experience
- Skills: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, PPC
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience: dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Target job:
Title: ${$json.job_title}
Company: ${$json.company}
Description (first 800 chars): ${($json.description || '').substring(0, 800)}

Make it specific to this role. Mention how Jerry can help:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words.
Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.

Return ONLY the cover letter text, no subject line, no formatting labels.` }}
